## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `SetupGuide`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `googleapis-calendar-setup-guide`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **SetupGuide**.

## Step 2: Create a Google Cloud Platform project

1. <!-- manual: Open the [Google Cloud Platform console](https://console.cloud.google.com/). -->
2. <!-- manual: Select the project drop-down menu in the top navigation bar. -->
3. Select an existing project or select **New Project** to create a new one.
4. Enter a project name (for example, `Ballerina Calendar Integration`).
5. Select **Create**.
6. <!-- manual: Enter a project name (for example, Ballerina Calendar Integration) and select Create. -->

## Step 3: Enable the Google Calendar API

1. <!-- manual: In the GCP console, navigate to APIs & Services › Library. -->
2. <!-- manual: Search for Google Calendar API. -->
3. Select **Google Calendar API** result.
4. Select **Enable**.

## Step 4: Configure the OAuth consent screen

1. <!-- manual: Navigate to APIs & Services › OAuth consent screen. -->
2. Select **External** as the user type (or **Internal** if you are using Google Workspace and only need access within your organization).
3. <!-- manual: Fill in the required fields: -->
4. - **App name**: Enter a name (for example, `Ballerina Calendar Connector`).
5. <!-- manual: App name: Enter a name (for example, Ballerina Calendar Connector). -->
6. <!-- manual: User support email: Select your email address. -->
7. <!-- manual: Developer contact information: Enter your email address. -->
8. Select **Save and Continue**.
9. On the **Scopes** page, select **Add or Remove Scopes** and add:
10. <!-- manual: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/calendar -->
11. Select **Save and Continue** through the remaining steps.

## Step 5: Create OAuth client credentials

1. <!-- manual: Navigate to APIs & Services › Credentials. -->
2. Select **Create Credentials** and select **OAuth client ID**.
3. Set the **Application type** to **Web application**.
4. Enter a name (for example, `CalendarConnector`).
5. <!-- manual: Enter a name (for example, CalendarConnector). -->
6. <!-- manual: Under Authorized redirect URIs, add: https://developers.google.com/oauthplayground -->
7. Select **Create**.
8. <!-- manual: Copy the Client ID and Client Secret from the dialog that appears. -->

## Step 6: Obtain a refresh token

1. <!-- manual: Open the [Google OAuth 2.0 Playground](https://developers.google.com/oauthplayground). -->
2. <!-- manual: Select the gear icon in the top-right corner and check Use your own OAuth credentials. -->
3. <!-- manual: Enter your Client ID and Client Secret. -->
4. <!-- manual: In the left panel under Step 1: Select & authorize APIs, find Calendar API v3 and select the scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/calendar. -->
5. Select **Authorize APIs** and sign in with your Google account. Grant the requested permissions.
6. In **Step 2: Exchange authorization code for tokens**, select **Exchange authorization code for tokens**.
7. <!-- manual: Copy the Refresh token from the response. -->
